/docs/install/astro/.title: Astro setup
/docs/install/astro/.body: Run `npx astro add askstatic` and add the <AskStatic /> component to a layout.

/docs/install/wordpress/.title: WordPress setup
/docs/install/wordpress/.body: Upload the plugin zip in Plugins > Add New and activate it.

/docs/install/html/.title: HTML setup
/docs/install/html/.body: Copy the script tag from the docs into your page footer.

/pricing/.title: Pricing
/pricing/.body: There is a free plan for personal sites. Paid plans start at $9 per month.

/legal/refunds/.title: Refund policy
/legal/refunds/.body: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase.

/docs/languages/.title: Languages
/docs/languages/.body: English and Bulgarian are built in. Other languages can be added with a language pack.

/docs/privacy/.title: Privacy
/docs/privacy/.body: Nothing is sent anywhere. All matching happens in the visitor's browser.

/docs/requirements/.title: Requirements
/docs/requirements/.body: Astro 5 or newer and Node 22.12 or newer.

/docs/theming/.title: Theming
/docs/theming/.body: Override the CSS variables such as --askstatic-accent on the widget element.

/docs/knowledge/.title: Knowledge format
/docs/knowledge/.body: Put one YAML or JSON file per topic in src/askstatic with questions, an answer and sources.

/docs/pagefind/.title: Search fallback
/docs/pagefind/.body: When no entry matches, the widget shows Pagefind results from the rest of your site.

/docs/how-it-works/.title: How it works
/docs/how-it-works/.body: No. Answers are selected from your own pre-written entries; no model runs in the browser or on a server.

/docs/performance/.title: Performance
/docs/performance/.body: Nothing loads until the chat is opened. The engine and index are fetched on first use.

/license/.title: License
/license/.body: MIT licensed. Commercial use is allowed.
